Okay, so I can’t really prove this in any way, but on part 2 of the DMR questline, I got stuck on 9/10 kills for some reason. I killed plenty of people after the nineth one, but it never dinged.

Anecdotal context:
I was using an SR-25 at night time Interchange. I got in a big fight at the start that got me most of the way there. Checked and saw 9/10, so I stopped worrying about it. About two hours later (still in the same raid) I extract with somewhere between 30 and 40 kills scavs and pmc and the last guy I kill was a PMC that I didn’t get the dog tag from.

I’ve no idea if my little story here is helpful, but figured I’d at least give you some info on what I was doing, since I really don’t have anything else.

comments.author: House16
comments.body_html:
It def is helpful thank you, I will use the info you gave me to see if there is anything on my end that needs to be fixed or if maybe it is just something funky that happened. For whatever reason that questline has given me problems in the past so tbh wouldn’t be surprised if I missed something or something got messed up. If I find an issue ill edit this in the future incase your interested lol.

Edit: I think I figured out why, I somehow forgot to add to the quest information that you need headshots to complete the quest. So for example the task says

“Eliminate PMCs with DMR”

but should be

“Eliminate PMCs with a headshot using a DMR”

This is most likely why it seemed like no progress was made. So while yes you were killing PMCs they were not headshots and had no idea that you needed headshots lolol

I checked to make sure all DMRs are set to be used in the quest as well and some other things and they were good. It will be fixed in next update.

Thanks for letting me know. I wouldn’t have caught this on my own.
